In conclusion, we addressed CWI and LCP using LLMs, specifically Llama-based and OpenAI’s GPT models. We observed that these models can determine the word difficulty level in multiple domains and languages, although with limited performances. Meanwhile, these models struggle to label very difficult phrases correctly.
